pull_requests.title: feat(show): list the newest trips first
pull_requests.body: People filing a monthly mileage claim look for the trips they logged last, which sat at the bottom of a long list. milepost show now lists trips newest first by the day of the trip, numbered from 1 at the top. log and total are unchanged.

pull_requests.title: feat(cli): add a drop command to remove a mistaken trip
pull_requests.body: A mistyped trip could only be fixed by editing milepost.json by hand. milepost drop N removes trip number N, the number show prints beside it, and prints the trip it removed. It exits 1 and changes nothing when no trip has that number.
